passages.text: Our class builds a model of Earth for a map activity. A thin line goes through the ball, and its top end has a North Pole label. We make a system of numbered cards and matching labels to organise the activity. Each card gives a place name and asks a pupil to find it on the model. Ben checks that every card number has the right label before the game starts. Mia holds the model while younger pupils take turns choosing their cards. The cards help us share the model without everyone reaching for it at once.

parallelText.en: Our class builds a model of Earth for a map activity.
parallelText.zh: 我们班为地图活动制作地球模型。

parallelText.en: A thin line goes through the ball, and its top end has a North Pole label.
parallelText.zh: 一条细线穿过球体，顶端有一个北极标签。

parallelText.en: We make a system of numbered cards and matching labels to organise the activity.
parallelText.zh: 我们制作一套编号卡片与对应标签组成的系统，组织活动。

parallelText.en: Each card gives a place name and asks a pupil to find it on the model.
parallelText.zh: 每张卡给出一个地名，请学生在模型上找到。

parallelText.en: Ben checks that every card number has the right label before the game starts.
parallelText.zh: 游戏开始前，本检查每个卡号是否对应正确标签。

parallelText.en: Mia holds the model while younger pupils take turns choosing their cards.
parallelText.zh: 米娅拿着模型，较小的学生轮流选卡。

parallelText.en: The cards help us share the model without everyone reaching for it at once.
parallelText.zh: 卡片帮助我们共享模型，避免所有人同时伸手拿。

wordHelp.meaning: arrange things so an activity can work well

passages.text: In winter, my family visits Grandma in the north of our country. It is freezing on the morning we arrive, and even the puddles have ice. Grandma waits inside her warm house and waves from the window. Before going into the garden, we put on thick coats and gloves. We check the empty bird feeder and add some food from Grandma's cupboard. Then we return inside and watch from the window while sharing a hot meal. The visit is a chance to help Grandma and enjoy being together, even on a cold day.

parallelText.en: In winter, my family visits Grandma in the north of our country.
parallelText.zh: 冬天，我们一家去我国北部看望奶奶。

parallelText.en: It is freezing on the morning we arrive, and even the puddles have ice.
parallelText.zh: 我们到达那天早晨极冷，连小水洼都结了冰。

parallelText.en: Grandma waits inside her warm house and waves from the window.
parallelText.zh: 奶奶在温暖的屋里等候，从窗边挥手。

parallelText.en: Before going into the garden, we put on thick coats and gloves.
parallelText.zh: 去花园前，我们穿上厚外套，戴上手套。

parallelText.en: We check the empty bird feeder and add some food from Grandma's cupboard.
parallelText.zh: 我们查看空的喂鸟器，从奶奶柜里取些食物放进去。

parallelText.en: Then we return inside and watch from the window while sharing a hot meal.
parallelText.zh: 接着我们回屋，一边吃热饭，一边从窗边看。

parallelText.en: The visit is a chance to help Grandma and enjoy being together, even on a cold day.
parallelText.zh: 即使天气寒冷，这次拜访也让我们有机会帮助奶奶，享受相聚。
